title: Postal Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer responsible for postal operations, mail management, and postal finance activities in support of MAGTF operations.

title: Personnel Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer responsible for personnel administration, manpower management, and human resources operations across MAGTF elements.

title: Basic Intelligence Officer
description: Entry-level Marine Corps Warrant Officer designation in the intelligence field, serving as qualifying MOS for warrant officer intelligence billets.

title: Senior All-Source Intelligence Analysis Officer
description: Senior Marine Corps Warrant Officer specializing in all-source intelligence analysis, fusion, and production in support of MAGTF commanders.

title: Counterintelligence/Human Intelligence Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer specializing in CI and HUMINT collection, operations planning, and source development in support of all echelons.

title: Surveillance Sensor Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer managing organic ground and aerial surveillance sensor systems, sensor data exploitation, and ISR integration.

title: Geographic Intelligence Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer responsible for geospatial intelligence production, terrain analysis, and GEOINT support to MAGTF operations.

title: Basic Infantry Officer
description: Entry-level Marine Corps Warrant Officer designation in the infantry field, serving as the basic qualifying MOS for infantry warrant officer billets.

title: Infantry Weapons Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer designated as the Infantry Weapons Officer (The Gunner), serving as the principal advisor to commanders on employment of all organic and supporting infantry weapons, fire support integration, and close air support.
notes: Marine Corps Warrant Officer MOS — Iconic USMC Gunner designation

title: Basic Logistics Officer
description: Entry-level Marine Corps Warrant Officer designation in the logistics field, qualifying warrant officers for assignment across supply, maintenance, and motor transport logistics billets.

title: Mobility Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer responsible for airlift planning, cargo/passenger manifesting, and air delivery coordination in support of MAGTF mobility operations. Legacy designation; may be documented on older DD-214s.
notes: Marine Corps Warrant Officer MOS — legacy designation

title: MAGTF Plans Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer serving as a plans officer within the Marine Air-Ground Task Force (MAGTF) command element, responsible for operational and campaign planning support.

title: Basic Communications Officer
description: Entry-level Marine Corps Warrant Officer designation in the communications field, qualifying warrant officers for assignment across voice, data, and tactical communications billets.

title: Telephone Systems Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer specializing in telephone and wire communications systems, including installation, operation, and maintenance of tactical wireline networks.

title: Metal Worker Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer with expertise in metal fabrication, welding, structural repair, and field maintenance of metal components across MAGTF engineer and maintenance units.
notes: Marine Corps Warrant Officer MOS — warrant variant; enlisted MOS 1316 also exists

title: Engineering Assistant Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer providing engineering staff support including site reconnaissance, construction surveying, drafting, and technical engineering documentation for MAGTF combat engineering operations.

title: Electronics Maintenance Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer responsible for management and technical supervision of electronics maintenance activities across ground electronics, communications, and sensor systems.

title: Motor Transport Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer responsible for motor transport operations, fleet management, vehicle maintenance oversight, and ground transportation support to MAGTF elements.

title: Marine Corps Community Services Officer
description: Marine Corps Warrant Officer overseeing Marine Corps Community Services programs including morale, welfare, recreation, retail operations, and family support activities.
